tools.name: cross_chain_bridges
tools.description: List bridge protocols (/supported/bridges). Both from_chain and to_chain are independently optional: omit both for the full catalog, pass from_chain only for bridges on that source chain, pass to_chain only for bridges able to reach that destination, pass both for bridges that connect the specific chain pair. Returns bridgeId / bridgeName / supportedChains[].

Source chain (independently optional). See tool description for the
four combinations of from_chain / to_chain.

tools.name: cross_chain_status
tools.description: Query cross-chain status by source chain transaction hash (/status). `bridge_id` is REQUIRED — server returns 50014 without it. Returns SUCCESS / PENDING / NOT_FOUND.

bridge_id.description:
Bridge id (required by server — returns 50014 if absent). Get it from the
`bridgeId` field of the prior `cross_chain_execute` / `cross_chain_quote`
result, or from `cross_chain_bridges`.

from_chain.description:
Source chain name or chainIndex (e.g. "ethereum" or "1"). Required —
server returns 50014 (chainIndex) without it.

order_id.description:
Order id from a prior cross_chain_execute (e.g. swapOrderId,
approveOrderId). Use this OR `tx_hash`. Resolved internally to a tx hash
via the authenticated wallet `/order/detail` endpoint (login required).

tx_hash.description:
Source chain transaction hash returned by cross-chain execute. Provide this
OR `order_id` (mutually exclusive).

tools.name: cross_chain_tokens
tools.description: List bridgeable tokens (/supported/tokens). Both from_chain and to_chain are independently optional: omit both for the full catalog, pass from_chain only for tokens on that source chain, pass to_chain only for tokens that can reach that destination, pass both for tokens on the specific from→to route. Returns chainIndex / tokenContractAddress / tokenSymbol / decimals.

from_chain.description:
Source chain (independently optional). See tool description for the
four combinations of from_chain / to_chain.

tools.description: Probe an HTTP 402 / A2MCP endpoint, parse the challenge, preflight balance, rank candidates, and return a paymentId to confirm before paying. Read-only; never signs.

method.description:
HTTP method to probe with ("GET" by default). Use "POST"/"PUT"/"PATCH"
for A2MCP endpoints whose paid call is not a GET — known params then ride
in the JSON body instead of the query string.

param.description: Known business params as "key=value" strings (optional, repeatable).

url.description: The A2MCP / merchant endpoint URL to probe.

tools.name: payment_session
tools.description: Run an MPP channel-session op (open/voucher/topup/close); the CLI decides reuse-vs-sign, cumulative amount, top-up need, and refund.

challenge.description: WWW-Authenticate / 402 challenge value (as required by the op).

cumulative_amount.description:
Prior authorized cumulative amount (atomic string). The decision layer
adds unit_amount to this; omit for the first voucher (treated as 0).
NOTE: this is the PRIOR cumulative (unit_amount is added on top), NOT the
absolute new cumulative — the opposite of the CLI's
`payment session voucher --cumulative-amount`, which takes the absolute
new cumulative and derives `unit = new − prior` internally (the CLI has
persisted session state; this stateless MCP entry does not).

from.description: Payer address (optional; defaults to selected account).

reuse_signature.description: Existing voucher signature to reuse (reuse-vs-sign signal).

server_cumulative.description: Seller-reported cumulative from a 70015 drift error; forces a resign.

unit_amount.description: Per-voucher unit amount (atomic string), for voucher.
